The '''Celestial Timecharm''' is a {{Special}} [[Rift Timecharms|Rift Timecharm]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Celestial Timecharm''' can be obtained from {{NPCSprite|Shen Citrinitas}} after completing the third sequence in {{Zone|Cerebral Citadel}}.

== Usage ==
The player can secure the '''Celestial Timecharm''' in the {{zone|Rift Gallery}} to gain {{SkyBlock XP|+100}}.

=== Game Message ===
Securing the '''Celestial Timecharm''' will result in the following message, which will be broadcast to the entire lobby:
{{TextSection|boxed=true|text={{Dialogue|&d&lRIFTASTIC! &7[player] &ehas secured &cCelestial Timecharm&e into their gallery! &6gg&e!}}}}
=== Rift Necklace ===
{{Main|Rift Necklace}}
Securing the '''Celestial Timecharm''' will add additional [[stats]] to the [[Rift Necklace]] both inside and outside the [[Rift Dimension]].
